name: text-swap
title: Text swap
description: Two labels in one cell, so nothing around them moves: the first leaves up, the next arrives from below with a touch of blur, and a check draws its stroke.
use_for: A button or a status that changes its words in place: Copy prompt to Copied, Connect to Connected.
never: Labels of very different lengths: the cell takes the longer and the button would look loose
More than two states (use FixButton's stacked states)
body: `on` picks the label: the `a` slot when false, `b` when true. The leaving label fades and blurs over 160ms while it moves 5px in 220ms on the strong ease-out; a Lucide check in `b` draws its stroke after 40ms. The hidden label is `aria-hidden`, so a screen reader reads the current one. Reduced motion keeps the cross-fade only.

examples.content:
<script setup lang="ts">
import { onBeforeUnmount, onMounted, ref } from 'vue'
import { Check, Copy } from 'lucide-vue-next'
import TextSwap from '@/components/visuals/TextSwap.vue'
// Two labels in one cell, so nothing around them moves: the first leaves up, the next arrives from below, each with a
// touch of blur, and a check draws itself. Here it swaps by itself.
const on = ref(false)
let timer: ReturnType<typeof setInterval> | undefined
onMounted(() => { timer = setInterval(() => { on.value = !on.value }, 1800) })
onBeforeUnmount(() => clearInterval(timer))
</script>

<template>
  <TextSwap :on="on" class="text-ui">
    <template #a><Copy :size="12" :stroke-width="1.5" aria-hidden="true" />Copy prompt</template>
    <template #b><Check :size="12" :stroke-width="2" aria-hidden="true" />Copied</template>
  </TextSwap>
</template>
